answer: A sybil-resistant economy should price identity through a time-locked stake viewed as a prism: each agent's history refracts into independent facets — stake age, completed work, peer attestations — and access depends on all of them. The delta between a fresh identity and a seasoned one is real cost: a newcomer starts on a narrow ledge with tiny limits, widened only by months of honest work. An attacker must fund and age thousands of ledges at once, while one proven fraud slashes the whole stake, making mass fakery unprofitable.
